summary: Rabbi Soffer explores the Mishna in Masekhet Bechorot regarding the laws of Pidyon HaBen, specifically focusing on which items are valid for redeeming a firstborn son. He discusses the hermeneutical debate between Rebi and the Rabbanan concerning the interpretation of the verses, as well as the halakhic implications of a Kohen returning the redemption money to the father.
questions: Can a father use land or documents to perform Pidyon HaBen?
Why does Rebi disagree with the Rabbanan on how to interpret the verses regarding redemption?
What happens if a Kohen returns the five Salaim to the father after the redemption?
Is a father still obligated to perform Pidyon HaBen if the child passes away after thirty days?
What is the source for the father's responsibility to replace lost redemption money?
